## Need and proposed behavior

Describe the user workflow, concrete trigger, and desired result.

## Scope and acceptance

Describe which protocol, panel, configuration, or simulation behavior is involved and how it can be meaningfully verified. Identify deferred work and relevant compatibility constraints.

## Independent implementation

Identify behavioral references without proposing copied or translated implementation code. Original project work must remain MIT-licensed; identify any proposed dependency separately.
